title: Headless The Legend of the Star (VMS09) and A Valuable Lesson (VMS09a): Festus's star info (20), the stars deposited (30), the prize vault opened (VMS09a 10) and Allen Marks's holotape carried out (VMS09a 100, complete)

actions.text: Path: at the Sunset Sarsaparilla Headquarters Festus (NVCRFestus) tells the player about the stars (SSHQFestusStarInfo, end script: VMS09 20); with 50 Star Bottle Caps the player deposits them (SSHQFestusDepositStars 0x0010595A: objective 20 completed, 30, a Fail Quest stage: the prize is only the Legend of the Star) and complains (SSHQFestusKiddingMe: the prize room door unlocked, VMS09a 10); in the prize vault the player takes Allen Marks's holotape and, standing in the vault's trigger with it (SSHQAllenMarksTriggerScript, OnTrigger), sets VMS09a 100 (Complete Quest, 1500 XP). VMS09 stage 10 is set by nothing in FalloutNV.esm (the quest is not start-game enabled; SetStage 20 starts it). Stand-ins: travel by move_player; the 50 star caps collected across the Mojave by add_item; the vault's robots and the walk to the trigger by trigger_enter.
Stand-in for the hunt: the player has found 50 Sunset Sarsaparilla Star caps.
Stand-in for the walk through the unlocked prize room door into the vault: the player takes Allen Marks's holotape (its default activation) and stands in the trigger.
